baseline.method: word-tokenized prose from chapters/01 and chapters/02 combined; markers and headings stripped; captured from these same two chapters after they were rewritten for voice consistency, so this baseline is a fit against itself, not an independent sample, and book-level drift against it measures near zero. Re-captured under the corrected engine (roadmap row 1.7, voice registers): type_token_ratio is now a moving average over 100-token windows, which is length-invariant by construction, so a single chapter measured against this book-level baseline no longer inflates type_token_ratio the way the flat-ratio predecessor did (chapter 1 alone now measures 0.7498, chapter 2 alone 0.7490, versus 0.7329 combined here -- a small residual gap, not the roughly 0.09 gap the flat ratio produced).
